title: scariola albertoregelia
intro: Scariola albertoregelia, commonly known as Albert's root or Scariola, is a type of plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Scariola albertoregelia include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and support the health of the gastrointestinal tract. The bioactive constituents of Scariola albertoregelia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
